answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint a verifiable identity tied to a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Minting requires staking an escalating bond that hardens like basalt, scaling exponentially with network density so any Sybil swarm suffers superlinear capital exhaustion. Staked tokens burn when identities churn at the speed of a comet, leaving behind a frozen relic record that penalizes duplicate actors.
